entities.summary: Amós Acero Pérez was a Spanish Socialist Workers' Party politician under the Second Spanish Republic. He was born in Villaseca de la Sagra as the 3rd of 7 children. After the victory of the Nationalist faction in the Spanish Civil War, he was arrested by the new authorities. Following an investigation of his past by the Brigada Político-Social, he was brought to trial and was executed by the government of Francisco Franco in Madrid.

entities.summary: Amós Acero Pérez was a Spanish Socialist Workers' Party politician under the Second Spanish Republic. He was born in Villaseca de la Sagra as the 3rd of 7 children. After the victory of the Nationalist faction in the Spanish Civil War, he was arrested by the new authorities. Following an investigation of his past by the Brigada Político-Social, he was brought to trial and was executed by the government of Francisco Franco in Madrid.
